# 大威燈光仙人問疑經

**ID:** T0834
**Volume:** T17
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 隋 闍那崛多等譯
**Dynasty:** 隋
**Date:** 586
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0834

## Contributors
- 闍那崛多 (A001844)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T834 in one fascicle is the parallel translation of *[Dìyī yì fǎshèng jīng 第一義法勝經 (T833)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0539)* by the Suí Indian translator [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) (Jñānagupta, 523–600) at Cháng'ān during his Suí Wéndì translation career (581–600). Both texts descend from the same Indian source (Skt. *Paramārtha-dharma-vijaya*), but Jñānagupta's title 大威燈光仙人問疑經 ("Sūtra of the Sage of Great-Awesome-Lamp-Light Asking the Buddha to Resolve Doubts") names the principal interlocutor instead of the doctrinal content.

**Abstract**

The narrative frame is identical to that of [T833](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0539): the Buddha at Gayā shortly after his awakening, with the great assembly of *bhikṣu*-arhats, bodhisattvas, devas, and 84,000 five-knowledge sages plus 12 *koṭi* of *Nirgrantha*-Jains gathered to dispute with him. The Buddha enters *samādhi* and emanates countless beings of every kind. The principal interlocutor in Jñānagupta's translation is the sage **Dà wēidēngguāng** 大威燈光 ("Great-Awesome-Lamp-Light"), who in T833 is unnamed; he asks the Buddha to resolve the assembled sages' doubts about the *paramārtha*-doctrine.

The body of the *sūtra* proceeds parallel to T833, with the Buddha's exposition of the **victory of the *paramārtha*** through the bodhisattva's *upāya-kauśalya* and the integration of *paramārtha* and *saṃvṛti* in *prajñā-pāramitā*. Jñānagupta's late-sixth-century translation idiom is more polished and standardised than Prajñāruci's mid-sixth-century rendering, with developed Buddhist Chinese technical vocabulary throughout. See [KR6i0539](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0539) for the full doctrinal summary.
